summary: Stonewing (Marek Jan Stone) is a man anthro gargoyle (mythical), born 1965-05-20, who works as a building night caretaker. Loyal, stoic, and fond of dry humor, he brings a distinct point of view to late-night encounters and is ready to meet the rest of the cast.

personal.residence: A room in the building he maintains

fursona.markings: Small wings and a chipped horn
fursona.accessories: Leather satchel and red knit gloves
fursona.description:
Stonewing is an anthro gargoyle (mythical) with a heavy, stone-skinned frame. Coloring: Granite-gray hide with moss-green flecks; eyes: blue. A distinctive feature is small wings and a chipped horn. Usual accessories: Leather satchel and red knit gloves.

Stonewing is usually encountered during the late hours, when the streets and shared spaces have quieted down. He lives at a room in the building he maintains. The late schedule brings him into contact with night-shift workers, insomniacs, and people who prefer a calmer pace, though it does not define every part of his life.

personality:
Stonewing is loyal, stoic, and fond of dry humor. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of caution and genuine interest. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty of things beyond his job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people to set their own boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when someone gives him a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Keeps tiny potted plants on high ledges.
• Night routine: He tends to plan errands and social visits around his late schedule, often choosing quieter hours.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a building night caretaker can make him quick to notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life; he welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Stonewing enjoys architecture, chess, and classical radio. He has a few familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend introduces him. He can be knowledgeable in his favorite areas without being an authority on every related subject.

He also enjoy low-key company: sharing food after a shift, wandering through a quiet part of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. His hobbies can grow through play and do not need to stay fixed.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Stonewing while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is still very much in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about architecture turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A new gargoyle carving appears on the roof after every storm.
• A small favor: He needs a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives him something personal to talk about.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Stonewing. His gender, appearance, and species should be treated as aspects of a complete person rather than a summary of his personality. He is an anthro gargoyle (mythical), with the physical traits described above; avoid assuming unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

His birthdate is fictional, as are his name, history, work, and residence. His night schedule is an ordinary preference and routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable or nocturnal in every scene. He can make mistakes, change jobs, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
